M7 — 2026-10-04
The private prompt buffer (r3-fixes 2.9) is at $XDG_STATE_HOME/sofar/prompts/<clone key>/<session id>.jsonl (default ~/.local/state/sofar/...), with one {"id":"P<n>","ts","text"} row per prompt. When a write-back's brief_append "P<n>" warns "no prompt P<n> was captured", read that file for the session. If it is missing, either capture was off (SOFAR_PROMPT_CAPTURE=off, or an `off` marker in that directory) or the host sent no prompt. The clone key is the first 32 hex chars of sha256(realpath of the checkout), so each worktree has its own buffer.
